y-m-55-02.title: Ukulawula iingcambu ze-x²+kx+4=0 nge-k
y-m-55-02.topic: Inani neempawu zeengcambu zokwenyani zenkcazelo yesibini
y-m-55-02.goal: Hlola, ngokwenza imizekelo, ukuba kwinkcazelo yesibini equlathe unobumba k inani neempawu zeengcambu zokwenyani zitshintsha ngexabiso le-k, uze uchaze ngamanani ukuba kutheni k i-positive ingasebenzi.
y-m-55-02.material: k yi-constant yokwenyani, kwaye izisombululo zenkcazelo x²+kx+4=0 (x isikwere kunye no-k amaxesha x kunye no-4 kulingana ne-0) ziqwalaselwa phakathi kwamanani okwenyani kuphela. Ukuba utshintsha k, inani neempawu zezisombululo zokwenyani zitshintsha.

y-m-55-02.prereq.0: Intsingiselo yeengcambu (izisombululo) zenkcazelo yesibini namava okwahlula ngeenkalo iintetho zefom x²+px+q (inqanaba lesikolo samabanga aphakathi)
y-m-55-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke k apho le nkcazelo inesisombululo esinye sokwenyani ncam.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.hint.0: Uqala ngamaxabiso amancinci afana no-k = 0, 2, faka amaxabiso ambalwa kwi-x uhlole ukuba x²+kx+4 inokuba yi-0 na.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ixabiso elincinci kakhulu lentetho kufuneka libe yintoni ukuze igrafu ichukumise nje i-x-axis, uze uphinde ubhale x²+kx+4 ngefom (x+k/2)² + (…) uchaze eli xabiso ngokwe-k.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.a: Kwi-x²+4=0, x² kuya kufuneka ibe yi-negative, ngoko akukho sisombululo sokwenyani kwaphela. Phinda ujonge xa isisombululo esinye sivela.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.b: Oku kukucinga okuzama ukubhala kwakhona intetho ngefom yesikwere esigqibeleleyo.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.c: Njenge-x²+2x+4 = (x+1)²+3, ihlala i-positive, ngoko akukho sisombululo. Isisombululo asivi nje ngenxa yokuba k ayiyi-0.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.d: Oku kukucinga okujonge k enophawu oluchasayo ngendlela efanayo.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.e: Kulula ukucinga ukuba k ikhulu kangakanani, izisombululo ziyanda. x²+8x+4=0 inezisombululo zokwenyani ezimbini ezahlukeneyo.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.explain: Ukuba k=4, ngoko x²+4x+4 = (x+2)², kwaye ukuba k=−4, ngoko x²−4x+4 = (x−2)², ngoko kukho isisombululo esinye (isisombululo esiphindiweyo). Kwi-k=0 nakwi-k=2 akukho sisombululo, kwaye kwi-k=8 kukho izisombululo ezimbini ezahlukeneyo.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.prompt: Faka amanani apheleleyo k ama-3 ahlukeneyo apho x²+kx+4=0 inezisombululo ezimbini ezahlukeneyo zokwenyani ezi-positive.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.hint.0: Lungisa k enye, sombulula x²+kx+4=0 ngokuthe ngqo, uhlole ukuba izisombululo ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ziyaphuma.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ukuba ufumene izisombululo, jonga iimpawu ubone ukuba zombini zi-positive na, kwaye ukuba hayi, tshintsha uphawu lwe-k uvavanye kwakhona.

y-m-55-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Zombini izisombululo azizi-positive. Hlola iimpawu zezisombululo ngokuthe ngqo.

y-m-55-07.s.s2.o.b: Xa ubunzima bamanzi kwiikomityi ezimbini bufanayo
y-m-55-07.s.s2.r.b: Ukuba nobunzima obufanayo bamanzi akuthethi ukuba bonke ubunzima bamanzi anetyuwa bufanayo.
y-m-55-07.s.s2.o.c: Xa umahluko wokuhlukana okubini mncinci kakhulu
y-m-55-07.s.s2.r.c: Ukuba umahluko mncinci ziyasondelana, kodwa aziyi kulingana ngqo.
y-m-55-07.s.s2.o.d: Xa bonke ubunzima bamanzi anetyuwa kwiikomityi ezimbini bufanayo
y-m-55-07.s.s2.r.d: Oku kukucinga okwasebenza ngebinzana imeko apho umndilili wokuhlukana usebenza khona.
y-m-55-07.s.s2.explain: Ukuba ubunzima bamanzi anetyuwa bufanayo m, ukuhlukana okuxutyiweyo yi-(m·p + m·q)÷(2m) = (p+q)÷2. Xa ubunzima betyuwa kuphela bufanayo okanye ubunzima bamanzi kuphela bufanayo, akubi ngumndilili.
y-m-55-07.s.s3.prompt: Bhala umyalezo wokuthumela uBoram. Usebenzisa amanani, bhala ukuba kutheni kungeyiyo i-6%, nokuba kufuneka kusetyenzwe ntoni ukufumana ukuhlukana kwenyani kule meko.
y-m-55-07.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale ubunzima betyuwa kwikomityi nganye kwezimbini, uze emva koko ubhale isixa sazo.
y-m-55-07.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala bonke ubunzima bamanzi anetyuwa emva kokuxuba, uze uguqule ixabiso lesixa setyuwa esahlulwe ngobunzima bonke libe yipesenti.
y-m-55-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba umyalezo ubonisa ngobubele apho kutshintshile, ngaphandle kokummangalela uBoram?
y-m-55-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba amanani endiwabhalileyo (inani letyuwa, ubunzima bonke, ukuhlukana) anxulumene ngokuchanekileyo?
y-m-55-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ubandakanye isitatimenti esithi 'ukuba amanani ayafana, umndilili uchanekile,' okanye, nokuba awuzange, isizathu sicacile?
y-m-55-07.s.s3.model.0: Boram, awunakuthatha nje umndilili wokuhlukana. U-B unamanzi anetyuwa amaninzi kakhulu, i-300 g, ngoko ukuhlukana okupheleleyo kusondele kwelika-B. Ityuwa ingu-10 g kuA kunye ne-6 g kuB, isixa se-16 g, kwaye i-16 g kwi-400 g yi-4%.
y-m-55-07.s.s3.model.1: Xa uxuba, ubunzima betyuwa buyadibana kwaye ubunzima bamanzi anetyuwa buyadibana. Ngoko kufuneka ufumane (10+6)÷(100+300)×100=4%. Ukuba amanani amanzi anetyuwa amabini ahlukile, umndilili olula awuchanekanga.
y-m-55-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Umyalezo obhalwe ngamabinzana kuphela nawo uyasebenza.

y-m-55-09.title: Sinokubhala nini (a+b)² njenge-a²+b²?
y-m-55-09.goal: Hlola impazamo yokukholelwa ukuba ibinzana elijongwe ngexabiso elinye okanye amabini lihlala lisebenza, uze wenze imizekelo yokujonga indlela umahluko phakathi kwe-(a+b)² nowe-a²+b² uchazwa ngayo nokuba uba ngu-0 nini.
y-m-55-09.material: UDaeun ucinga ukuba (a+b)² = a²+b². (Indlela yokulifunda: 'isikwere sika-a kunye no-b silingana nesikwere sika-a kunye nesikwere sika-b.') Xa wavavanya ngokufaka a=3, b=0, (3+0)²=9 kunye no-3²+0²=9, ngoko lalilungile. Cinga, ngamazwi kuphela, ngomfanekiso apho isikwere esikhulu esinecala le-a+b sahlulwe saba sisikwere esinye esinecala le-a, isikwere esinye esinecala le-b, kunye neengxande ezimbini ezinobubanzi be-a nobude be-b.

y-m-55-09.thinking.1: Ukwenza imizekelo emininzi enelisa imeko (umahluko ungu-12)
y-m-55-09.prereq.0: Ukufumana ixabiso lebinzana ngokufaka amanani endaweni yoonobumba (inqanaba lesikolo samabanga aphakathi)
y-m-55-09.prereq.1: Imodeli yendawo: amava okwahlula isikwere esinecala le-a+b sibe sisikwere esinye esinecala le-a nesinye esinecala le-b kunye neengxande ezimbini ezinobubanzi be-a nobude be-b

y-m-55-09.s.s1.o.b: Ukubala kuphume kulungile, ngoko bubungqina obaneleyo bokuba ibinzana lihlala lisebenza
y-m-55-09.s.s1.r.b: Oku kukucinga okuthathe ukubala okulungileyo njengokufanayo nokusoloko kusebenza.

y-m-55-09.s.s1.r.c: Akunjalo ukuba onke amabinzana angalunganga abonakala elungile xa ufaka u-0. Zama ukufaka u-0 kwamanye amabinzana ukuze ujonge.
y-m-55-09.s.s1.o.d: a=3 yipozithivu, ngoko ihlala isebenza kwii-a nezi-b eziyipozithivu
y-m-55-09.s.s1.r.d: Oku kukucinga okuthethe ngawo onke amanani aziipozithivu esebenzisa ixabiso elinye. Zama ukufaka amanye amanani aziipozithivu ukuze uvavanye.
y-m-55-09.s.s1.explain: Ukuba b=0, onke amalungu aqulathe b ayanyamalala, ngoko nebinzana elingalunganga lingabonakala lilungile ngethamsanqa. Umzekelo omnye awuqinisekisi 'rhoqo'. Lo mzekelo unika kuphela ulwazi lokuba kukho iimeko apho kulungile.
